h1: What type of transporter will move the animals?

headings.text: What type of transporter will move the animals?

paragraphs: Your transporter must hold a valid transporter authorisation, issued by DAERA or APHA in the UK if they are:
Find out how to transport animals in connection with an economic activity (opens in new tab)
Documents issued by DAERA are valid for use in GB.
Documents issued in any EU Member State are not valid for use in GB.
